name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - a basic Forest that lets a fixed-cost green spell like Malevolent Rumble be cast once a second green source is up. Green Sun's Zenith never triggers this selector: an X-cost hand card is excluded from unlocks entirely, because the engine only ever judges an X spell's payability at its cheapest legal announcement, X=0, which is never proof the X a play actually wants is payable. This never costs life, so it goes first: a land this good is never worse than holding it. Prefers a basic Forest first (the only untapped green source this deck's own one-drops need), then Eldrazi Temple by its own 'colorless Eldrazi' text. Mosswort Bridge never reaches this selector at all - it always enters tapped, so it can never satisfy enters_any: [untapped] - but Ugin's Labyrinth can (it always enters untapped; its own imprint trigger is answered may/choose_cards regardless of whether a legal exile target is in hand), and so can Cavern of Souls (untapped, unconditional creature-type choice), so both answers ride along on this move. Stands down once four or more untapped mana is already up - the same key cast-trigger-land-search's own guard reads, so the two never overlap. Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Stands down once two or more colorless mana-value-7-or-greater cards are in hand: the seat-admitted imprint-land-exile-least-castable play takes over the whole land-drop decision there (its own true key, byte-identical here), the same discipline prison-tron's open-labyrinth-land already uses against open-tron-land.
